name: Dwarven Doughtiness
text: Your mind is as hard to sway as your feet are to move. At the end of your turn, reduce your frightened condition value by 2 instead of by 1.

name: Dwarven Lore
text: You grew up immersed in dwarven traditions. You become trained in Crafting and Religion (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Dwarven Lore.

name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
text: You have access to uncommon dwarf weapons. You treat weapons with the dwarf trait, plus battle axes, picks, and warhammers, as one proficiency category simpler (martial as simple, advanced as martial). At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Mountain Strategy
text: You learned to fight against your ancestral enemies. You deal an additional 1 circumstance damage (increasing with weapon damage dice) to creatures with the giant, goblin, hryngar, or orc trait, and to any creature that critically hits you.

name: Rock Runner
text: Your feet are sure on stone. You ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth. You aren't off-guard while Balancing on narrow surfaces of stone and earth, and successes on Acrobatics checks to Balance there become critical successes.

name: Stonemason's Eye
text: You become trained in Crafting (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). The GM rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual stonework even when you aren't Searching.

name: Unburdened Iron
text: You've learned to carry armor at a determined pace. Ignore the reduction to your Speed from any armor you wear, and reduce any other penalty to your Speed by 5 feet.

name: Ancestral Longevity
text: You have accumulated a vast array of experience. During your daily preparations, you can reflect on your life to become temporarily trained in one skill of your choice until the next time you prepare.

name: Elven Lore
text: You studied in traditional elven arts. You become trained in Arcana and Nature (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Elven Lore.

name: Elven Weapon Familiarity
text: You have access to uncommon elf weapons. You treat weapons with the elf trait, plus longbows, composite longbows, rapiers, shortbows, and composite shortbows, as one proficiency category simpler. At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Forlorn
text: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and successes on those saves become critical successes.

name: Nimble Elf
text: Your muscles are tightly honed. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Otherworldly Magic
text: Your elven magic manifests as a simple spell. Choose one arcane cantrip; you can cast it as an innate arcane spell at will.

name: Unwavering Mien
text: Your mystic control is difficult to disrupt. Reduce the duration of mental effects on you by 1 round (a 1-round effect is negated). You still get a saving throw against sleep effects even when asleep, and improve their outcome by one degree.

name: Burn It!
text: Fire fascinates you. Your spells that deal fire damage gain a status bonus equal to half the spell's rank; fire-damaging alchemical items gain a status bonus of a quarter of the item's level (minimum +1 either way). You also gain a +1 status bonus to any persistent fire damage you deal.

name: City Scavenger
text: You know how to survive on urban scraps. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Subsist checks (+2 with the irongut heritage), can Subsist in a settlement using Society or Survival, and can attempt to Earn Income while Subsisting in a city.

name: Goblin Lore
text: You picked up skills from your extended goblin family. You become trained in Nature and Stealth (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Goblin Lore.

name: Goblin Scuttle
text: Reaction. Trigger: an ally ends a move action adjacent to you. You take advantage of the opening: you Step.

name: Goblin Song
text: One action. You sing an annoying goblin song: attempt a Performance check against the Will DCs of up to two enemies within 30 feet. On a success the target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round (crit: 1 minute).

name: Goblin Weapon Familiarity
text: You have access to uncommon goblin weapons. You treat weapons with the goblin trait as one proficiency category simpler (martial as simple, advanced as martial). At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Junk Tinker
text: You can make useful tools out of scrap. You can Craft shoddy level-0 items, including weapons and armor, from junk at one-quarter the usual Price; you don't take the usual penalties for a shoddy item you made yourself, and junk grants a discount when you Craft any item.

name: Rough Rider
text: You gain the Ride feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites, and you're an expert at riding goblin dogs and wolves: you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Command such an Animal serving as your mount.

name: Very Sneaky
text: Taller creatures rarely look down. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the Sneak action, and you can Sneak between cover as long as you end the move in cover or concealment.

name: Adapted Cantrip
text: Through study of humanity's magical versatility, you've adapted a spell from another tradition: swap one of your cantrips for a common cantrip of the same rank from another tradition's spell list.

name: Cooperative Nature
text: The short human life span lends perspective on teamwork. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.

name: General Training
text: Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities. You gain a 1st-level general feat of your choice (you must meet its prerequisites).

name: Haughty Obstinacy
text: Your powerful ego makes you hard to control. Successes on saves against effects that would make you act against your will become critical successes, and foes who fail to Coerce you get a critical failure instead.

name: Natural Ambition
text: You were raised to be ambitious. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class (you must meet its prerequisites).

name: Natural Skill
text: Your ingenuity allows you to learn a wide variety of skills. You become trained in two skills of your choice.

name: Unconventional Weaponry
text: You've familiarized yourself with a particular weapon. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon; you gain access to it and treat it as one proficiency category simpler if it's from another culture's tradition.

name: Animal Accomplice
text: You build a rapport with an animal, which becomes magically bonded to you. You gain a familiar. The type of animal is up to you, but most gnomes choose animals with a burrow Speed.

name: Animal Elocutionist
text: You hear animal sounds as conversations instead of unintelligent noise, and you can respond in turn. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression on animals.

name: Fey Fellowship
text: Your enhanced fey connection affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the fey realm as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and saving throws against fey. Whenever you meet a fey creature in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression on it rather than needing to converse for 1 minute, taking a -5 penalty to the check; on a failure, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check instead.

name: Fey World Magic
text: Your connection to the fey realm grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Gnome Obsession
text: You might have a flighty nature, but when a topic captures your attention, you dive into it headfirst. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore. As gnome obsessions can come and go quickly, you can retrain Gnome Obsession to a different Lore subcategory in 1 day of downtime.

name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity
text: You favor unusual weapons tied to your people. You gain access to kukris and all uncommon weapons with the gnome trait. You treat weapons with the gnome trait, plus the glaive and kukri, as one proficiency category simpler (martial as simple, advanced as martial). At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Illusion Sense
text: Sensing illusion magic is second nature to you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and Will saves against illusions. When you come within 10 feet of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check for you to disbelieve it, even if you didn't spend an action to Interact with the illusion.

name: Razzle-Dazzle
text: Free action, once per hour. Trigger: you blind or dazzle a creature. You've practiced the manipulation of light. Extend the duration of the blinded or dazzled condition you give the target by 1 round.

name: Distracting Shadows
text: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction. You can use creatures that are at least one size larger than you (usually Medium or larger) as cover for the Hide and Sneak actions, though you still can't use such creatures as cover for other uses, such as the Take Cover action.

name: Folksy Patter
text: You are adept at disguising coded messages as folksy idioms. Using slang, jokes, and halfling loanwords, you convey a simple message consisting of three basic words. Your intended listener can attempt a DC 20 Perception check to discern the message (reduced by 5 if the listener is a halfling or has Folksy Patter, or by 10 if both apply). Eavesdroppers can attempt a Perception check against your Deception DC to discern your meaning.

name: Halfling Lore
text: You've dutifully learned skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition. You become trained in Acrobatics and Stealth (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Halfling Lore.

name: Halfling Luck
text: Free action, once per day. Trigger: you fail a skill check or saving throw. Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity
text: You favor traditional halfling weapons. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the halfling trait. You treat weapons with the halfling trait, plus the sling and shortsword, as one proficiency category simpler (martial as simple, advanced as martial). At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Prairie Rider
text: You grew up riding your clan's shaggy ponies and riding dogs. You become trained in Nature (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also get a +1 circumstance bonus to Command an Animal if the target is a traditional halfling mount, such as a pony or riding dog.

name: Sure Feet
text: Whether keeping your balance or climbing, your feet easily find purchase. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to Balance or an Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead. You're not off-guard when you attempt to Balance or Climb.

name: Titan Slinger
text: You have learned how to use your sling to fell enormous creatures. When you hit on an attack with a weapon of the sling group against a Large or larger creature, increase the size of the weapon damage die by one step.

name: Unfettered Halfling
text: You have trained to ensure you'll never be caught or held again. Whenever you roll a success on a check to Escape or a saving throw against an effect that would impose the grabbed, immobilized, or restrained condition on you, you get a critical success instead. Whenever a creature rolls a failure on a check to Grapple you, it gets a critical failure instead.

name: Watchful Halfling
text: You pay close attention to the people around you, noticing when they act out of character. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when using Sense Motive to notice enchanted or possessed characters; if you aren't actively using Sense Motive, the GM rolls a secret check without the bonus for you to notice anyway. You can also use the Aid basic action to grant a bonus to another creature's check to overcome enchantment or possession.

name: Grasping Reach
text: You can extend a tangle of vines or tendrils to support your arms and extend your reach. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands, doesn't have reach, and deals at least 1d6 damage, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed grasp using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended grasp gain reach of 10 feet, but this grasp is less stable and powerful, reducing the weapon's damage die by 1 step.

name: Harmlessly Cute
text: Your size and demeanor make it easy to convince others that you mean no harm. You gain the Shameless Request skill feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative checks when you roll Deception for initiative.

name: Leshy Lore
text: You deeply understand your people's cultural traditions and innate strengths. You become trained in Nature and Stealth (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Leshy Lore.

name: Leshy Superstition
text: Reaction. Trigger: you attempt a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, but haven't rolled yet. You focus on the power of a lucky object, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw against the triggering effect.

name: Seedpod
text: Your body produces a nearly endless supply of hard seedpods. You gain a seedpod ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, a seedpod bursts, imposing a -10-foot circumstance penalty on the target's Speed until the start of your next turn. Seedpods do not add critical specialization effects.

name: Shadow of the Wilds
text: It's difficult to notice your passage through wild areas. As long as you're not in an urban environment, you're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.

name: Undaunted
text: Your spirit has endured many challenges over its long existence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Beast Trainer
text: You have an impressive innate ability to tame and command ferocious beasts. You become trained in the Nature skill (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead) and gain your choice of the Pet general feat or the Train Animal skill feat.

name: Hold Mark
text: You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community's prowess. Choose one emblem: Burning Sun (Diplomacy, arcane), Death's Head (Survival, primal), Defiled Corpse (Religion, divine), or Empty Hand (Intimidation, occult). You become trained in the listed skill and gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells from the listed tradition.

name: Iron Fists
text: Your fists have been forged by battle, your naturally tough skin and dense bone further hardened by conflict. Your fist unarmed attacks no longer have the nonlethal trait and gain the shove weapon trait.

name: Orc Ferocity
text: Reaction, once per day. Trigger: you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed. You refuse to fall from your injuries: you avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1.

name: Orc Lore
text: The hold elders taught you your people's histories and shared the hardships your ancestors endured. You become trained in Athletics and Survival (if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice instead). You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Orc Lore.

name: Orc Superstition
text: Reaction. Trigger: you attempt a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, and have not yet rolled. You defend yourself against magic by relying on techniques derived from orc cultural superstitions, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw against the triggering spell or magical effect.

name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
text: In combat, you favor the brutal weapons that are traditional for your orc ancestors. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the orc trait. You treat weapons with the orc trait, plus the falchion and greataxe, as one proficiency category simpler (martial as simple, advanced as martial). At 5th level you gain critical specialization effects with these weapons.

name: Tusks
text: You have particularly long, jagged tusks perfect for tearing meat from bone. You gain a tusks unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your tusks are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits. Special: you can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can retrain out of it only through drastic measures.

name: Earned Glory
text: You are experienced at telling stories of your accomplishments to gain the respect of elves. You become trained in Performance (if you would automatically become trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice). You gain the Impressive Performance feat. When you attempt a Performance check to Make an Impression on an elf, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Elf Atavism
text: Your elven blood runs particularly strong. You gain the benefits of the elf heritage of your elven parent or ancestors. You typically can't select a heritage that depends on or improves an elven feature you don't have. Special: you can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

name: Monstrous Peacemaker
text: Your dual nature has given you a unique perspective, allowing you to bridge the gap between humans and the many intelligent creatures that humans consider monsters. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks against non-humanoid intelligent creatures and against humanoids that are marginalized in human society, and on Perception checks to Sense the Motives of such creatures.

name: Orc Sight
text: Your orc blood grants you the keen vision of your forebears. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light; in darkness, you see in black and white only. Special: you can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
